post.description: Runs one action as one of your end users, on connectionId or on the end user's newest active connection of the action's app. The input is checked against the action's input schema before anything is sent; the action is sent once and never retried. Send an Idempotency-Key to retry safely.

parameters.description: A retry with the same key never runs the action again and is never charged again: it answers the first run's result, or idempotency_conflict while the first run is still in progress. AIsa never retries a run for you.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

default.description: Error. The code field is stable; see the error catalog.

x-aisa-pricing.description: Charged once per action run that succeeded, at the price per run shown here: AIsa's own cost for the run. This is the price on every plan; no plan multiplier applies. A run that did not succeed is never charged: refused before it is sent (invalid input, no connection, reconnect required, unknown action, rate limited), failed in the app, failed in AIsa or the app integration, or with an unknown outcome. Every run answers its charge in X-AISA-Customer-Cost-Micros-USD. Reading the catalog, connecting and listing connections are free.

post.description: Connects an app account with credentials the end user brings, named as the app names them. Send them in credentials; apiKey is shorthand for credentials.apiKey, so an app that takes only a key needs only apiKey, and Shopify takes {"apiKey": "<Admin API access token>", "credentials": {"shopDomain": "<shop>.myshopify.com"}}. A missing required field or a field the app does not take is refused with invalid_request; credentials the app rejects are connect_failed. The app checks them before the connection is made; AIsa neither stores nor returns them.

apiKey.description: The app's API key; shorthand for credentials.apiKey. Send it once.

credentials.description: The credentials the app takes (for its api_key or custom_credential auth type), as strings.

externalUserId.description: Your id for the end user the account belongs to.

default.description: Error. The code field is stable; see the error catalog.
